verdict.rationale: User-defined automation rules are a plausible feature for a business-services SaaS platform, so this axis applies. However, the evidence shows only fixed, vendor-defined behaviors: mail-arrival alerts, deadline reminders, compliance notifications and annual-report auto-filing. Nothing documents a user defining their own event-triggered rules or actions, so these are adjacent built-in features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
